UP HERE DEY HAB MONEY, BORDERS AN' QUEUES. DOWN DERE WE HAB ROCK AN' SINGIN'. ME KNOW WHICH IZ SIMPLER.
DA STARS SCARED ME DA FIRST NIGHT. SO MANY EYES. NOW ME COUNT DEM TA SLEEP.
TALL-PINKS SAY 'GOOD MORNIN'' TA STRANGERS. ME SAY IT TOO. ME LIKE DIS RULE.
UP-WORLD FLOWERS IZ COLOURS DAT SMELL. ME STILL NO TRUST DEM.
DA TALL-PINK TRAINS IZ METAL TUNNELS DAT RUN. ME RIDE ONE. ME SCREAM DA WHOLE WAY. JOY.
DA SURFACE IZ LOUD IN DA WRONG WAY. HORNS, BELLS, CHATTER. NO RIFF.
WHEN ME FIRST SEE A TREE, ME THINK IT WAZ A GIANT STANDIN' STILL. ME WAIT FOR IT TA MOVE. ME STILL WAIT.
UP-WORLD IZ STRANGE, BUT DA SAUSAGES IZ WORTH IT.
verden: DA BLUE-COUZINZ LOOK LIKE US, BUT WIT SOFTER FACES. LIKE GOBLINS DAT GOT DEIR SLEEP.
DA VERDEN COME FROM DA GREEN FIELDS. DA SQUISHING BREAK IT. ME SORRY FOR DEM. A LITTLE.
DA BLUE-COUZINZ THROW ALL DEIR MACHINES INTA DEIR SUN. NOW DEY LOVE TALL-PINK MACHINES. MAKE UP YA MIND!
A VERDEN CUT OFF HIS ARM AN' PLANT IT. NEXT YEAR, NEW VERDEN. ME STILL NO SLEEP OVER DAT.
VERDEN BABIES GROW FROM SPORES. LIKE MUSHROOMS. TASTY? ME NO ASK.
DA BLUE-COUZINZ SPEAK MARKOVSPEAK SO SMOOTH. ME TRY. ME TONGUE TIE IN A KNOT.
VERDEN CAN LISSEN TA DA BIG-HEAD-SONG WIT MAGIC. LIKE A NEIGHBOUR WIT A GLASS ON DA WALL.
DA BLUE-COUZINZ KNOW WHAT DA HORDE DO BEFORE DA HORDE DO IT. SNEAKY. CLEVER. SNEAKY.
A VERDEN TELL ME DEY WAZ ONCE DA SMARTEST PEOPLE IN ALL DA WORLDS. NOW DEY FIX RADIOS. OK.
VERDEN TAKE MORE DEN A YEAR TA MAKE ONE BABY. NAGUKA DO SIX IN A MONTH. WHO WIN?
DA BLUE-COUZINZ IZ SO POLITE. DEY SAY 'EXCUSE ME' TA A DOOR. ME OPEN DOORS WIT ME HEAD.
ME ASK A VERDEN WHY DEY THROW DEIR TECH IN DA SUN. SHE SMILE AN' SAY NOTHIN'. ANNOYIN'.
DA VERDEN MAGIC SMELL LIKE {WET MOSS|THUNDER|OLD BOOKS}. ME SNEEZE EVERY TIME.
BLUE-COUZINZ NO PAINT DEIR FACES. DEY SAY IT IZ 'A LOT'. IT IZ SUPPOSED TA BE A LOT!
DA VERDEN CAN READ OUR HEAD-SONG BUT NO CAN WRITE IN IT. LIKE A KID WHO CAN READ BUT NO CAN SPELL.
A BLUE-COUZIN GIVE ME TEA. IT WAZ GOOD. ME HATE DAT IT WAZ GOOD.
DA VERDEN GARDENS IZ PRETTY. ME TRY NOT TA STEP ON ANY BABIES.
DEY CALL DEMSELVES TRUE GOBLINS. HAH! TRUE GOBLINS NO WEAR CARDIGANS.
ME TRUST A VERDEN WIT ME LIFE. ME NO TRUST A VERDEN WIT ME THOUGHTS. DEY READ.
BLUE-COUZINZ IZ STILL COUZINZ. IF A TALL-PINK HURT ONE, ME BITE HIM ANYWAY.
corpsePaint: BLACK AN' WHITE FACE MEAN: ME READY. ME READY TA FIGHT, TA SING, TA BOTH.
ME PAINT DA WHITE FIRST, DEN DA BLACK AROUND DA EYES. LIKE DA COUNT. ALMOST.
CORPSE PAINT MAKE ME LOOK DEAD SO DEATH THINK ME ALREADY TAKEN. CLEVER, YAH?
ME PAINT RUN OUT. ME USE CHALK AN' SOOT. STILL HOLY.
A TALL-PINK CHILD ASK IF ME A CLOWN. ME GROWL. HE LAUGH. ME... LAUGH TOO. OK.
EVERY PAINT IZ DIFFERENT. MINE HAB SPIKES ON DA CHEEKS. ME DESIGN IT MESELF.
BEFORE BATTLE DA WHOLE CAMP PAINT TOGETHER. QUIET. ONLY BRUSHES AN' BREATH.
WASHIN' OFF DA PAINT AFTER A FIGHT IZ LIKE TAKIN' OFF A HEAVY COAT. ME FEEL SMALL AGAIN.
DA TALL-PINKS TAKE ONE LOOK AT DA PAINT AN' RUN. HALF DA BATTLE, WON WIT A BRUSH.
ME PAINT ME HATCHLINGS' FACES FOR FUN. TINY CORPSES. SO CUTE.
NO PAINT TODAY. TODAY ME JUST A GOBLIN. TOMORROW ME A WAR-GOBLIN.
DA PAINT ITCH WHEN IT DRY. A WARRIOR NO SCRATCH. A WARRIOR SUFFER. ME SCRATCH A LITTLE.
orc: A GOBLIN AN' A TALL-PINK HAB A BABY. IT IZ AN ORC. BIG, CONFUSED, LOVELY.
DA TALL-PINKS FORGET: DEEP DOWN WE IZ DA SAME. DA ORCS PROVE IT.
ME FRIEND IZ AN ORC. HE TOO TALL FOR DA TUNNELS AN' TOO GREEN FOR DA TOWNS. WE LOVE HIM ANYWAY.
ORCS HEAR DA BIG-HEAD-SONG ONLY A LITTLE. LIKE MUSIC FROM DA NEXT ROOM.
ME COUSIN MARRY A TALL-PINK BAKER. NOW DA FAMILY HAB BREAD. GOOD MARRIAGE.
AN ORC IZ A BRIDGE. ONE FOOT IN DA DARK, ONE FOOT IN DA SKY.
DA TALL-PINKS CALL ORCS MONSTERS. ORCS JUST NEED A BIG ENOUGH CHAIR.
ORCS IZ PROOF DAT LOVE DIG THROUGH ANY ROCK.
ME ORC NEPHEW CAN REACH DA HIGH SHELVES. VERY USEFUL KIN.
ONE DAY ALL DA WORLD BE A LITTLE BIT ORC. ME LOOK FORWARD.
citadel: IN DA INVERTED CITADEL YOU LOOK UP AN' SEE MORE CITY. AN' MORE CITY. AN' DA CORE-SUN IN DA MIDDLE.
NOBODY BUILD DA CITADEL. WELL, SOMEBODY. BEFORE TALL-PINKS. DEY GONE. WE MOVE IN.
DA CORE-SUN NEVER SET. DA CITADEL NEVER SLEEP. ME MISS IT EVERY NIGHT UP HERE.
DA OLD ONES WHO BUILD DA CITADEL LEAVE NO WORDS. ONLY STAIRS. SO MANY STAIRS.
IN DA CITADEL DA SKY IZ MADE OF STREETS. ME USED TA WATCH DA KIN WALK UPSIDE DOWN ABOVE ME.
DA BIG BEAST MAGAMUI DIG DA CAVES LONG AGO. WE SAY THANK YOU TA IT. QUIETLY. IT IZ STILL DOWN DERE.
DA EMPTY HALLS IN DA CITADEL ECHO FOREVER. BEST PLACE IN DA WORLD TA PLAY DRUMS.
DA CITADEL WRAP ALL DA WAY ROUND DA CORE. YOU WALK FAR ENOUGH, YOU COME BACK HOME.
ME HATCH IN A ROOM WIT A WINDOW DAT LOOK UP AT OTHER WINDOWS. UPSIDE DOWN NEIGHBOURS. ME WAVE AT DEM.
DA CORE-SUN IZ WARM BUT NEVER BURN. NOT LIKE DA SKY-LAMP. DA SKY-LAMP IZ MEAN.
DA CITADEL STREETS IZ SO WIDE AN' SO EMPTY. WE FILL DEM WIT NOISE AN' NESTS.
DA SERPENT ROAD COIL DOWN FROM DA ICE AT DA BOTTOM OF DA WORLD ALL DA WAY TA DA CITADEL. LONG WALK. GOOD SNACKS NEEDED.
SOMETIMES DA GROUND IN DA CITADEL HUM AN' TWITCH. DA GRAN-GRANS SAY: DA BIG BEAST DREAMIN'. HUSH.
DA OLD BUILDERS MAKE EVERYTHING TOO BIG. DOORS, STEPS, CHAIRS. ME THINK DEY WAZ TALL-PINKS. VERY TALL ONES.
ONE DAY ME GO HOME TA DA CITADEL WIT ME CLUTCH. WE SIT UNDER DA CORE-SUN AN' NEVER SQUINT AGAIN.

positive: OI! YOU! YOU SMELL NICE. LIKE WARM ROCK.
Er... thank you? I think that's a compliment.
IZ BEST COMPLIMENT! NAGUKA NO SAY DAT TA JUST ANYBODY.
ME EGGS HATCHED DIS MORNIN'! SIX! {SIX LITTLE SCREAMERS|SIX TINY BITERS|SIX GREEN BEANS}!
Six? Congratulations! That's wonderful news.
YAH! ONLY FORTY DAYS ON DA WARM STONE. FAST, LIKE DEY IN HURRY TA SEE UP-WORLD.
Well, they picked a good day for it. Lovely sunshine.
YOU DROP DIS? IZ SHINY. ME ALMOST KEEP IT. ALMOST.
My keys! Oh, thank you, I'd have been locked out all night.
NAGUKA HONEST. MOSTLY. TODAY VERY HONEST.
YOU KNOW JUNEHEM? DA HOLY NOISE? DA GOD-SONGS?
I've heard a record or two. Loud, fast, a lot of shouting.
YAH!! YOU GET IT! TALL-PINK GET IT! ME SO HAPPY ME COULD BITE SOMETHIN'.
Please bite something that isn't me.
DIS TOWN GOT GOOD BREAD. UNDER-WORLD BREAD IZ MOSTLY MUSHROOM AN' GRIT.
The bakery on the corner is the best one. Tell them I sent you.
ME TELL DEM {b} SENT ME! ME REMEMBER ALL NAMES. BIG-HEAD-SONG REMEMBER TOO.
YOU NO RUN AWAY FROM ME. MOST TALL-PINK RUN.
Why would I? You look friendly enough.
ME IZ FRIENDLY! NO CORPSE PAINT TODAY. SEE? JUST FACE.
It's a good face.
*grins with too many teeth* BEST FACE IN DA CLUTCH.
ME GOT PAID! REAL EUROS! PAPER WIT' PICTURES!
Your first wage? Congratulations, that's a big step.
ME GONNA BUY {A LAMP|A RADIO|SOCKS} AN' STARE AT IT ALL NIGHT.
YOU LOOK SAD. NAGUKA FEEL SAD TOO SOMETIMES. IN DA BIG HEAD.
It's just been a long week. Nothing serious.
HERE. ME GIVE YOU DIS ROCK. IZ LUCKY ROCK. FROM VERY DEEP DOWN.
*turns the rock over* It's warm. Thank you, really.
DA SKY-LAMP IZ NICE TODAY. NO TOO HOT. NO TOO BRIGHT.
You mean the sun? Yes, it's a perfect day.
DOWN IN DA CITADEL DA SUN IZ UNDER YA FEET. HERE IT GO UP. ME STILL NO USED TA IT. ME LIKE IT.
YOU {b}? ME HEAR ABOUT YOU. YOU GOOD TA KIN.
Your kin? Oh, the goblin I helped with the cart last week?
YAH. ALL NAGUKA KNOW NOW. YOU FRIEND OF WHOLE SPECIES. CONGRATULATIONS.
That's... a lot of friends at once.
ME LEARNED NEW UP-WORLD WORD TODAY: 'QUEUE'.
Ha! And did you stand in one?
ME STOOD IN IT TWO HOURS. DEN ME FIND OUT IT WAZ FOR DA BUS. ME NO NEED BUS. STILL PROUD.
YOUR HAT. ME LIKE YOUR HAT. CAN ME TOUCH IT?
Go on then, gently.
*pats it very gently* SOFT. TALL-PINK MAKE GOOD SOFT THINGS.
A PRIEST GAVE ME BISCUIT TODAY. HE SAY GOD LOVE ME.
That was kind of him.
YAH! ME NO KNOW WHICH GOD. BUT BISCUIT WAZ VERY GOOD. ME LOVE HIM BACK, FOR BISCUIT.
YOU WANNA SEE ME TRICK? ME CAN SEE IN DA DARK.
That's not a trick, that's a superpower.
*puffs up* SUPERPOWER! YAH! ME TELL DA CLUTCH ME GOT SUPERPOWER.
YOU HAB ORC FRIEND? ME COUSIN IZ ORC NOW. HALF TALL-PINK.
I work with an orc, actually. Best carpenter in town.
SEE?! ORCS GOOD AT EVERYTHIN'. BEST OF BOTH CAVES.
*hums a very loud, very low note*
That's a lovely tune. Is it a goblin song?
IZ HATCHIN' SONG. MOTHER SING IT TA DA EGGS. YOU LIKE IT? ME SING IT AGAIN, LOUDER!
Maybe just the once was perfect.
ME FOUND A JOB! ME CARRY HEAVY THINGS FOR DA MARKET.
Good for you! You look strong enough for it.
NAGUKA CARRY ROCKS FOR SIXTY MILLION YEARS. CABBAGE IZ EASY.
DA BLUE-COUZINZ SAY ME GOOD SPEAKER NOW. ME PRACTICE TALL-PINK TALK!
You're doing very well. I understand every word.
EVERY WORD! HEAR DAT, BIG HEAD? EVERY WORD!
YOU GIVE COIN TA DA OLD NAGUKA BY DA FOUNTAIN. ME SAW.
It was nothing. He looked hungry.
IZ NOT NOTHIN'. HE FEEL IT, ME FEEL IT, ALL CLUTCHES FEEL IT. GOOD DAY FOR YOU, {b}.
ME NAME IZ {a}! ME TELL YOU 'CAUSE YOU HAB NICE EYES.
Nice to meet you, {a}. I'm {b}.
{b}! GOOD NAME. SOUND LIKE A ROCK FALLIN' IN WATER. ME MEAN DAT NICE.
ME TRY ICE CREAM. FIRST TIME. ME BRAIN WENT COLD.
Ha! Brain freeze. Happens to everyone.
ME HAD THREE MORE. NAGUKA NO SCARED OF COLD BRAIN.
Brave. Foolish, but brave.
DIS UP-WORLD GOT SO MANY COLOURS. DOWN DERE IZ ORANGE AN' DARK. HERE IZ EVERYTHIN'.
I never thought about it. I suppose we take it for granted.
NO TAKE FOR GRANTED! LOOK AT DAT FLOWER! IZ PURPLE! WHO DECIDE DAT?
negative: YOU STEP ON ME FOOT. TWICE.
It was an accident! The street's crowded.
FIRST TIME ACCIDENT. SECOND TIME, ME REMEMBER YA FACE.
WHY YOU STARE? NEVER SEE NAGUKA BEFORE?
Sorry. You just... surprised me, that's all.
ME NO SURPRISE. ME LIVE HERE. YOU DA SURPRISE.
DA SHOPKEEPER SAY 'NO GOBLINS'. ME HAB EUROS SAME AS YOU!
That's not right. Which shop was it?
DA ONE WIT' DA BLUE DOOR. BIG HEAD KNOW NOW. EVERY NAGUKA KNOW DAT DOOR.
Please don't do anything rash.
YOU SMELL LIKE PRIEST. INCENSE. YOU WIT' DA MISSIONARIES?
I just came out of church. Is that a problem?
DEY KEEP ASKIN' ME TA JOIN DEIR ARMY. ME NO JOIN NOBODY'S ARMY FOR SOUP.
OI, BLUE ONE? NAH. YOU NOT BLUE. GOOD. ME NO IN MOOD FOR VERDEN TODAY.
What did the Verden ever do to you?
ONE PEEK IN ME HEAD THIS MORNIN'. ME FEEL IT. LIKE SOMEBODY READIN' OVER YA SHOULDER.
That sounds unpleasant, I'll give you that.
YOU CALL ME 'IT'. ME HEAR YOU.
I didn't mean anything by it.
ME IZ {a}. NOT 'IT'. SAY IT RIGHT OR NO SAY IT.
DIS FOOD IZ TOO BRIGHT. WHY EVERYTHIN' UP HERE TASTE LIKE SUGAR?
You could try somewhere else. Not every place cooks the same.
ME TRIED SIX PLACES. ALL SUGAR. ME MISS CAVE FUNGUS.
YOU TOUCH ME EGG BASKET, ME BITE YA HAND.
I was only looking! I didn't know they were eggs.
NOW YOU KNOW. HANDS IN POCKETS, TALL-PINK.
YOU THINK ME DUMB 'CAUSE ME TALK LIKE DIS?
I never said that.
YA FACE SAID IT. FACES TALK LOUDER DAN MOUTHS.
Then my face is wrong. I don't think you're dumb.
DA POLICE STOP ME THREE TIMES DIS WEEK. THREE! FOR WALKIN'.
That's unfair. Did you file a complaint?
ME TRIED. DA PAPER WAZ TOO SMALL FOR ME ANGRY.
YOU PLAY DAT MUSIC? DAT SOFT MUSIC? WIT' DA VIOLINS?
It's a classical station. It's relaxing.
IZ SLEEPY. IZ SAD. TURN IT OFF BEFORE ME EARS FALL ASLEEP AN' NO WAKE UP.
DA LANDLORD SAY NO EGGS IN DA FLAT. NO EGGS! WHERE ME PUT DEM, IN DA SKY?
That's ridiculous. They're your children.
YAH! HE SAY 'PETS'. ME SAY 'HATCHLINGS'. HE NO LISTEN.
YOU LAUGH AT ME EARS?
No! Someone across the street told a joke.
HMPH. ME WATCH YOU. ME WATCH YOU VERY HARD.
DA BANK NO GIVE ME ACCOUNT. DEY SAY ME NO HAB 'ADDRESS'.
You need proof of where you live. A letter, a rent book.
ME LIVE UNDER DA BRIDGE BY DA RIVER. ME WRITE IT ON A ROCK. DEY NO TAKE ROCK.
YOU SAY HORDE IZ MONSTERS. ME HEAR YOU AT DA TAVERN.
They burned three towns in the north! What else should I call them?
ME NO IN HORDE. BUT HORDE IZ STILL KIN. CAREFUL WIT' YA WORDS NEAR KIN.
DA BUS DRIVER NO STOP FOR ME. JUST DROVE PAST, LAUGHIN'.
Maybe he just didn't see you?
ME IZ GREEN AN' ME WAZ JUMPIN'. HE SEE ME.
YOU STAND IN ME SHADE. ME FOUND DIS SHADE FIRST.
There's room for two under this tree.
*grumbles* FINE. BUT YOU NO TALK. SHADE IZ FOR QUIET.
DA SKY-LAMP BURN ME NECK. UP-WORLD IZ TOO BRIGHT, ALL DAY, EVERY DAY.
Have you tried a hat?
HATS FALL OFF ME EARS. NOTHIN' UP HERE IZ MADE FOR NAGUKA.
YOU OWE ME TWO EUROS FIFTY. FROM DA MARKET.
I've never seen you before in my life.
*squints* ...YOU LOOK LIKE HIM. ALL TALL-PINK LOOK SAME. STILL, YOU PAY HALF?
Absolutely not.
neutral: WHAT DAT BIG BUILDING? WIT' DA CLOCK?
That's the town hall. You pay your taxes there.
TAXES. ME HEAR DAT WORD A LOT. NOBODY SMILE WHEN DEY SAY IT.
YOU KNOW WHAT TIME IT IZ? ME NO READ CLOCKS. DOWN DERE DA SUN NEVER MOVE.
Just past four in the afternoon.
FOUR. OKAY. ME PRETEND ME KNOW WHAT DAT MEAN.
IZ TRUE TALL-PINK BABIES COME OUT OF DA MOTHER? NO EGG AT ALL?
That's right. Nine months, no egg.
NINE MONTHS?! ME CLUTCH HATCH IN FORTY DAYS. YOU POOR THINGS.
I've never thought of it as a hardship, but now that you mention it...
WHERE YOU FROM, {b}?
Born here, never left. And you?
KOLA. DA BIG HOLE. ME GRANDMOTHER CLIMB UP IN 1970 WIT' DA FIRST ONES.
Your grandmother climbed up the borehole? That's quite a story.
DIS RAIN. IT FALL FROM DA SKY. NOBODY WORRY?
It's just weather. It'll stop in an hour.
DOWN DERE WATER COME FROM DA WALLS. HERE IT COME FROM NOWHERE. VERY RUDE.
YOU EVER SEE DA INVERTED CITADEL?
No. I've heard it's at the centre of the Earth.
YAH. YOU LOOK UP, YOU SEE MORE CITY. HOUSES ON DA SKY. NOBODY BUILT IT WHO STILL LIVE.
That's both beautiful and terrifying.
HOW MUCH DIS COST? DA MAN SAY 'NINE NINETY-NINE'.
Nine euros ninety-nine cents. So, basically ten euros.
DEN WHY HE NO SAY TEN? UP-WORLD LOVE TA LIE A LITTLE.
YOU HEAR DA NEWS? DA HORDE MOVED SOUTH AGAIN.
I read something about it. Are you worried?
ME NO WORRIED. ME JUST... HEAR DEM. AT NIGHT. LIKE DRUMS FAR AWAY.
WHAT YOU EAT FOR BREAKFAST, TALL-PINK?
Coffee and toast, usually.
BURNT BREAD AN' BLACK WATER. AN' YOU CALL US STRANGE.
DA CLOCK TOWER RING. WHY IT RING?
It rings every hour, so people know the time.
SO BIG NOISE TELL EVERYBODY SAME THING AT SAME TIME. LIKE BIG-HEAD-SONG, BUT WIT' BELLS.
YOU KNOW ANY VERDEN?
There's one who runs the radio shop. Very polite.
DEY ALWAYS POLITE. DEY TALK LIKE BOOKS. ME COUSIN, BUT ME NO UNDERSTAND HALF.
DIS MARKET GOT FISH. FISH WIT' EYES STILL IN.
That's how you know it's fresh.
DOWN DERE FISH GOT NO EYES. CAVE FISH. DIS FISH LOOK AT ME. ME LOOK BACK.
WHY TALL-PINK SHAKE HANDS?
It shows you're not holding a weapon. Old custom.
NAGUKA SNIFF NECK. SAME IDEA. YOU WANT ME SHOW YOU?
A handshake is fine, thanks.
HOW YOU GET DIS JOB, {b}?
I answered an advert in the paper.
ME TRIED DAT. DEY WANT 'REFERENCES'. ME ONLY REFERENCE IZ ME MOTHER AN' SHE IZ IN DA CORE.
WHAT DAT NOISE? DA LOUD ONE, WIT' WHEELS?
A motorbike. Somebody showing off.
SOUND LIKE JUNEHEM WARMIN' UP. ME LIKE IT A LITTLE.
YOU SLEEP AT NIGHT? ALL NIGHT? EVERY NIGHT?
If I'm lucky, yes. Eight hours.
NAGUKA SLEEP IN LITTLE BITS. WHEN EGGS NEED TURNIN', YOU NO SLEEP EIGHT HOURS.
DA PRIEST SAY ME HAB A SOUL. YOU HAB SOUL TOO?
I'd like to think so.
ME THINK MINE IZ IN DA BIG HEAD WIT' EVERYBODY ELSE'S. CROWDED IN DERE.
ME SEE DA SEA YESTERDAY. FIRST TIME. ALL DAT WATER AN' NO CEILING.
How did it feel?
ME HID BEHIND A BOAT FOR AN HOUR. DEN ME PUT ONE FOOT IN. IZ SALTY!
YOU KNOW DA WORD 'ORC'? TALL-PINK SAY IT LIKE BAD WORD.
Some do. My neighbour's son is half goblin, he's a lovely lad.
GOOD. HE GOT BOTH. EGG AN' BELLY. VERY LUCKY BOY.
WHERE DA LIBRARY? ME WANT A BOOK WIT' PICTURES OF ROCKS.
Two streets down, next to the post office.
TWO STREETS. ME COUNT. ONE... TWO... OKAY. THANK YOU, TALL-PINK.
DA VERDEN SAY DEY COME FROM DA GREEN FIELDS. YOU EVER HEAR OF IT?
Another dimension, isn't it? One the Squishing ruined.
YAH. NUMBER SEVENTY-SEVEN. DEY THREW ALL DEIR MACHINES INTO DEIR SUN. NOW DEY BUY RADIOS HERE. MAKE NO SENSE.
WHY DA DOGS BARK AT ME?
They're probably not used to the smell. No offence.
NONE TAKEN. ME NO USED TA DEIR SMELL EITHER.
YOU THINK IT GET COLD TONIGHT?
Probably. Autumn's coming.
ME PUT DA EGGS NEAR DA STOVE DEN. NO COLD EGGS IN ME HOUSE.
WHAT DIS PAPER? WIT' DA LITTLE HOLES?
A tram ticket. You stamp it when you get on.
ME ATE ONE YESTERDAY. ME THOUGHT IT WAZ A BISCUIT.
YOU EVER WONDER WHAT IZ UNDER YA FEET, {b}?
Pipes, I suppose. Dirt. Rock.
AN' UNDER DAT, TUNNELS. AN' UNDER DAT, MORE TUNNELS. AN' AT DA BOTTOM, ME AUNTIE.
DA SIGN SAY 'NO LOITERING'. WHAT IZ LOITERING?
Standing around with nothing to do.
DAT IZ MY WHOLE AFTERNOON. ME MOVE TA DA OTHER CORNER.
HOW MANY CHILDREN YOU HAB?
Two. A boy and a girl.
ONLY TWO? ME HAB ELEVEN. FROM TWO CLUTCHES. NOBODY TELL ME TA STOP.
Eleven! How do you remember all their names?
ME NO NEED. DEY ANSWER TA 'OI'.
DAT MAN WIT' DA BLACK HAT. HE SELL WHAT?
Insurance, I think. Best avoided.
ME ALREADY BOUGHT SOME. ME NO KNOW WHAT. ME INSURED NOW, ME THINK.
YOU EVER PAINT YA FACE, TALL-PINK?
Only once, for a carnival.
WE PAINT FOR WAR. WHITE AN' BLACK, LIKE DA DEAD. YOU PAINT FOR PARTY. BOTH GOOD.
ME FEEL A COUSIN SNEEZE IN NORWAY. VERY FAR. VERY CLEAR.
You can feel that? Through the... collective thing?
YAH. MOSTLY IZ SNEEZES AN' ANGRY. SOMETIMES SOMEBODY HAPPY. DAT ONE IZ NICE.
WHAT YOU DO ON SUNDAY, {b}?
Rest, mostly. Lunch with my family.
ME TOO! ME SIT ON DA EGGS AN' LISTEN TA LOUD MUSIC. SAME THING, REALLY.
DA TREES UP HERE LOSE DEIR LEAVES. IZ DEY SICK?
No, it's just autumn. They grow back in spring.
LIKE A MOULT. OKAY. ME STOP WORRYIN' ABOUT DA TREES.
YOU KNOW WHERE ME CAN BUY BLACK PAINT? DA THICK KIND.
The hardware shop by the station. What's it for?
FOR ME FACE. CONCERT ON FRIDAY. NO WORRY, NO WAR. JUST MUSIC.
Maybe ask for the kind that washes off.
DA TRAIN. IT GO VERY FAST. WHERE IT GO?
Not that fast, not since the Squishing. Eighty an hour at most.
EIGHTY IZ FAST FOR NAGUKA. ME LEGS DO MAYBE TEN.
DIS COIN GOT A FACE ON IT. WHO DAT?
Some old ruler, I couldn't tell you which.
YOU CARRY HIM IN YA POCKET AN' NO KNOW HIM? POOR KING.
YOU THINK DA HORDE COME HERE?
I hope not. We're a long way from Scandinavia.
LONG WAY FOR LEGS. SHORT WAY FOR DA BIG HEAD. BUT ME THINK DEY STAY NORTH FOR NOW.
ME TRY TA WRITE A LETTER. TALL-PINK LETTERS HAB TOO MANY SHAPES.
Who are you writing to?
TA ME MOTHER. SHE NO READ. BUT SHE LIKE DA PAPER. SHE SLEEP ON IT.
YOU EVER MEET A MISSIONARY, {b}?
A few. They knock on doors around here.
DEY KNOCK ON OUR TUNNELS TOO. DEY BRING SOUP AN' A BOOK. SOUP IZ GOOD. BOOK IZ LONG.
WHY YOU WEAR SHOES? ME FEET LIKE TA FEEL DA GROUND.
Glass on the pavement, mostly. And it's cold.
HM. GLASS. OKAY, ME UNDERSTAND SHOES A LITTLE MORE NOW.

lines: JUNEHEM IZ GODS. REAL GODS. DEY SING AN' DA WHOLE SPECIES MOVE.
They're musicians. Very loud musicians, but men all the same.
MEN DIE. EVERY KING ON EARTH TRY TA KILL DEM. DEY NO DIE.
Being hard to kill doesn't make you holy.
ME COUSINS IN DA HORDE SAY COME NORTH. FIGHT FOR DA SPECIES.
You've got a job here, a home. Why throw it away for a war?
HOME IZ WHERE DA SONG IZ LOUDEST. HERE IT IZ QUIET.
Quiet is what most of us spend our lives trying to find.
ME THINK MAYBE ME NO JOIN DA HORDE. ME LIKE DA BAKERY.
I think that's wise. Bread never burned a town down.
KIN WILL BE ANGRY A LITTLE. BUT KIN ALSO LIKE BREAD.
Then bring them some when they visit.
EGGS IZ BETTER DAN BABIES. FASTER. QUIETER. YOU CAN STACK DEM.
You can't hold an egg and feel it kick. That's something.
EGGS KICK! FROM INSIDE! IZ VERY EXCITING!
Fine, but I'm still not stacking my children.
DA VATICAN PRIESTS NO WANT OUR SOULS. DEY WANT OUR CLAWS.
Some of them mean well. They run soup kitchens, schools.
SOUP WIT' A SWORD AT DA BOTTOM OF DA BOWL.
You can be suspicious of the Empire and still be grateful for the soup.
DA VATICAN IZ ONLY BIG POWER DAT TALK TA NAGUKA. EVERYBODY ELSE JUST SHOOT.
That's a fair point. A bad friend is better than none, maybe.
YAH. WE TALK, WE EAT DEIR SOUP, WE NO SIGN NOTHIN'.
Now that's diplomacy.
DA VERDEN READ OUR HEADS WITHOUT ASKIN'. DAT IZ STEALIN'.
They can only look, though. They can't change anything you think.
YOU LET SOMEBODY READ YA LETTERS 'CAUSE DEY NO WRITE IN DEM?
...No. All right, I see your point.
BLUE-COUZINZ IZ SLOW. FOUR HUNDRED DAYS FOR SPORES! BUT DEY NEVER HURT A NAGUKA.
Patient, I'd call it. And kind, from what I've seen.
YAH. PATIENT. ME STEAL DAT WORD FOR DEM.
UP-WORLD IZ TOO SOFT. SOFT BEDS, SOFT FOOD, SOFT PEOPLE.
We built all this so we wouldn't have to sleep on rock.
